newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian farmhands kill two landless peasants.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian farmhands kill two landless peasants.

text.p: Two peasants were killed in southern Brazil just as President Fernando Henrique Cardoso was signing a decree that would have granted them rights to the land they farmed, a spokeswoman for a landless group said on Friday.

The spokeswoman for the Landless Movement (MST), which says it represents five million families, said the latest incident in a wave of violence that has swept Brazil's countryside took place in the state of Parana.
"Father and son were working the land and were hit by a number of bullets," the spokeswoman said, alleging the killers were farmhands on the estate where the two were squatting.
Officials said that at about the time of the shooting, Cardoso was signing a decree to force the landowner to sell the farm to the government for resettlement by landless squatters.

The incident brought to five the number of people killed in the past week in clashes between Brazil's powerful landowners and the dispossessed. Armed gunmen in the northern state of Para Monday executed three peasants.
